struct Solution;

// This is the MountainArray's API interface.
// You should not implement it, or speculate about its implementation
 struct MountainArray;
 impl MountainArray {
    fn get(&self, index:i32)->i32 { unimplemented!() }
    fn length(&self)->i32 { unimplemented!() }
}
